text_note.zh: 文字和语料库相同。只有断句按通行本：语料库把“井梧零乱惹残烟”连成一句，通行本断作“井梧零乱，惹残烟”。
text_note.en: The words are the same as in the corpus. Only one line break follows the common edition: the corpus runs the line about the well-side parasol trees and the mist together, while the common edition splits it in two.

readings.zh: “槛”在这里是栏杆，读 jiàn；读 kǎn 时是门槛。
readings.en: Here it means a railing and is read jiàn. Read kǎn, it means a doorsill.
It means in the setting sun, so it is read jiān.
It means answering each other, so it is read yìng.

readings.zh: “更阑”指夜深，“更”是古代夜里计时的单位，读 gēng。
readings.en: Here it is a night watch, an old unit of night time, so it is read gēng.

readings.zh: “那堪”是哪能忍受，“那”同“哪”，读 nǎ。
readings.en: This word means how can one bear it. The character is used like the question word nǎ, so it is read nǎ.

readings.zh: “少日”是年轻的时候，“少”读 shào。
readings.en: It means young days, so it is read shào.

readings.zh: “朝欢”是早上也寻欢作乐，“朝”是早晨，读 zhāo。
readings.en: It means morning, so it is read zhāo.

readings.zh: “长萦绊”是长久地被缠住，“长”读 cháng。
readings.en: It means for a long time, so it is read cháng.

readings.zh: “呜咽”是低低的哭泣声，“咽”读 yè。
readings.en: In the word for sobbing it is read yè.
It means a few, so it is read shù.

glosses.zh: 一霎：一会儿，很短的时间。
glosses.en: yī shà: a moment, a very short time.

glosses.zh: 庭轩：院子和带窗的长廊。
glosses.en: tíng xuān: the courtyard and the open hall beside it.

glosses.zh: 槛菊：栏杆边的菊花。槛，栏杆。
glosses.en: jiàn jú: chrysanthemums by the railing. Jiàn means a railing.

glosses.zh: 萧疏：稀稀落落，冷落的样子。
glosses.en: xiāo shū: thin and sparse, bleak.

glosses.zh: 井梧：井边的梧桐树。
glosses.en: jǐng wú: the parasol tree by the well.

glosses.zh: 惹残烟：沾着、缠着淡淡的烟雾。
glosses.en: rě cán yān: caught in thin, lingering mist.

glosses.zh: 凄然：心里凄凉悲伤。
glosses.en: qī rán: sad and lonely at heart.

glosses.zh: 江关：江上的关口，这里指远处的江山。
glosses.en: jiāng guān: a pass on the river; here, the distant land along the river.

glosses.zh: 黯淡：昏暗，不明亮。
glosses.en: àn dàn: dim, gloomy.

glosses.zh: 宋玉悲感：宋玉是战国时楚国的辞赋家，他在《九辩》里写秋天的悲凉，开头就说“悲哉秋之为气也”，所以后人常说“宋玉悲秋”。
glosses.en: sòng yù bēi gǎn: Song Yu was a poet of the state of Chu, more than two thousand years ago. In his long poem Jiu Bian he wrote about the sadness of autumn, so people later spoke of Song Yu grieving for autumn.

glosses.zh: 临水与登山：来到水边，登上高山。《九辩》里有“登山临水兮送将归”的句子。
glosses.en: lín shuǐ yǔ dēng shān: coming to the water and climbing the hills. Jiu Bian has a line about climbing hills and facing water to see someone off.

glosses.zh: 迢递：路途遥远的样子。
glosses.en: tiáo dì: far, far away.

glosses.zh: 凄楚：凄凉痛苦。
glosses.en: qī chǔ: sad and miserable.

glosses.zh: 陇水：陇山上流下的水。古诗里说陇头流水声音像哭声，听了让离家的人伤心。这里借指让人愁苦的流水声。
glosses.en: lǒng shuǐ: water flowing down from Mount Long. Old songs said its sound was like sobbing and made people far from home sad. Here it means any sad sound of flowing water.

glosses.zh: 潺湲：水慢慢流动的声音。
glosses.en: chán yuán: the sound of water flowing slowly.

glosses.zh: 蝉吟败叶：蝉在枯叶间鸣叫。
glosses.en: chán yín bài yè: cicadas singing among withered leaves.

glosses.zh: 蛩：蟋蟀。
glosses.en: qióng: a cricket.

glosses.zh: 衰草：枯黄的草。
glosses.en: shuāi cǎo: withered grass.

glosses.zh: 喧喧：声音嘈杂。
glosses.en: xuān xuān: noisy, many sounds together.

glosses.zh: 孤馆：孤零零的旅店。
glosses.en: gū guǎn: a lonely inn.

glosses.zh: 度日如年：过一天像过一年那么长，形容日子难熬。
glosses.en: dù rì rú nián: each day feels as long as a year; time drags.

glosses.zh: 悄悄：寂静无声。
glosses.en: qiāo qiāo: silent, very quiet.

glosses.zh: 更阑：夜深了。古人把一夜分成五更，阑是快完了。
glosses.en: gēng lán: late at night. People in old times split the night into five watches; lán means nearly over.

glosses.zh: 绛河：银河。
glosses.en: jiàng hé: the Milky Way.

glosses.zh: 皓月：洁白明亮的月亮。
glosses.en: hào yuè: the bright white moon.

glosses.zh: 婵娟：姿态美好的样子，这里形容月亮美。
glosses.en: chán juān: lovely and graceful; here, the beauty of the moon.

glosses.zh: 绵绵：连绵不断。
glosses.en: mián mián: going on and on.

glosses.zh: 夜永：夜很长。
glosses.en: yè yǒng: the night is long.

glosses.zh: 那堪：哪能忍受。
glosses.en: nǎ kān: how can one bear it.

glosses.zh: 屈指：弯着手指计算，这里指数算过去的岁月。
glosses.en: qū zhǐ: counting on one's fingers; here, counting the years gone by.

glosses.zh: 未名未禄：还没有功名，也没有官职俸禄。
glosses.en: wèi míng wèi lù: no fame from the exams yet, and no official post or pay.

glosses.zh: 绮陌红楼：繁华的街道和歌女住的楼，指城里热闹游乐的地方。
glosses.en: qǐ mò hóng lóu: fine streets and the red houses of singing girls, the lively places of pleasure in the city.

glosses.zh: 经岁迁延：一年又一年地在那里流连。迁延，拖延，留连。
glosses.en: jīng suì qiān yán: lingering there year after year.

glosses.zh: 帝里：京城，这里指北宋的都城汴京，就是今天河南开封。
glosses.en: dì lǐ: the capital; here Bianjing, the Northern Song capital, today's Kaifeng in Henan.

glosses.zh: 少日：年轻的时候。
glosses.en: shào rì: young days.

glosses.zh: 暮宴朝欢：晚上赴宴，早上又寻欢作乐，形容天天玩乐。
glosses.en: mù yàn zhāo huān: feasting at night and having fun again in the morning; pleasure every day.

glosses.zh: 狂朋怪侣：放纵不羁、行为特别的朋友。
glosses.en: kuáng péng guài lǚ: wild, unusual friends who did as they pleased.

glosses.zh: 当歌：面对着歌声。
glosses.en: dāng gē: facing songs.

glosses.zh: 竞留连：争着留下来，舍不得走。
glosses.en: jìng liú lián: each one eager to stay, unwilling to leave.

glosses.zh: 迅景如梭：时光过得像织布的梭子一样快。景，日光，指时光。
glosses.en: xùn jǐng rú suō: time flies like a weaver's shuttle. Jǐng here means daylight, that is, time.

glosses.zh: 烟水程何限：烟雾笼罩的水路，路程没有尽头。
glosses.en: yān shuǐ chéng hé xiàn: misty waterways, a journey with no end.

glosses.zh: 利名：钱财和名声。
glosses.en: lì míng: money and fame.

glosses.zh: 憔悴：又瘦又疲惫的样子。
glosses.en: qiáo cuì: thin and worn out.

glosses.zh: 萦绊：缠绕，牵绊。
glosses.en: yíng bàn: tangled up, held back.

glosses.zh: 空惨愁颜：白白地让脸上满是愁苦。
glosses.en: kōng cǎn chóu yán: a sad face, for nothing.

glosses.zh: 漏箭：古代计时用的漏壶里的箭形标尺，水慢慢漏下，标尺上的刻度显示时间。
glosses.en: lòu jiàn: the arrow-shaped marker in an old water clock. As water drips out, the marks on it show the time.

glosses.zh: 呜咽：低声哭泣，这里形容号角声低沉悲凉。
glosses.en: wū yè: low sobbing; here, the deep, sad sound of a horn.

glosses.zh: 画角：古代军中吹的号角，上面有彩绘。
glosses.en: huà jiǎo: a painted horn blown in army camps in old times.

glosses.zh: 停灯向晓：点着灯一直坐到天亮。停灯，留着灯不灭。
glosses.en: tíng dēng xiàng xiǎo: keeping the lamp lit until dawn.

glosses.zh: 抱影无眠：只有自己的影子陪着，一夜睡不着。
glosses.en: bào yǐng wú mián: with only his own shadow for company, he cannot sleep.

translation.en: The sky of late autumn.

translation.zh: 一阵小雨洒落在院子和长廊上。
translation.en: A brief, light rain falls on the courtyard and hall.

translation.zh: 栏杆边的菊花稀稀落落，
translation.en: The chrysanthemums by the railing are thin and sparse.
The parasol tree by the well is a mess of leaves,
caught in thin, lingering mist.
My heart is sad.
I gaze at the distant passes along the river.

translation.zh: 飞动的云在夕阳里显得昏暗。
translation.en: Drifting clouds look dim in the setting sun.
Long ago Song Yu grieved for autumn,

translation.zh: 也是在这样的时节临水登山。
translation.en: facing water and climbing hills in a season like this.
The road ahead is long and far.
The traveler is sad and weary,

translation.zh: 已经听厌了那让人伤心的潺潺流水声。
translation.en: tired of hearing the sad murmur of flowing water.
Cicadas sing among withered leaves,
crickets chirp in the dying grass,

translation.zh: 一声声互相应和，吵吵嚷嚷。
translation.en: answering each other in a noisy chorus.

translation.zh: 住在孤零零的旅店里，过一天像过一年。
translation.en: In a lonely inn, each day feels like a year.

translation.zh: 风和露水渐渐变得更冷，
translation.en: The wind and dew slowly turn colder,

translation.zh: 四下寂静，已经到了深夜。
translation.en: and in the silence the night grows late.
The wide sky is clear,
the Milky Way pale and shallow,
and the bright moon lovely.
My thoughts go on and on.

translation.zh: 长夜里面对这样的景色，
translation.en: Facing this scene through the long night,

translation.zh: 哪里忍受得了屈指数算过去的岁月，
translation.en: how can I bear to count the years on my fingers,
quietly thinking back to the past?

translation.zh: 那时还没有功名，也没有官职，
translation.en: Back then I had no fame and no post.

translation.zh: 在繁华的街道和歌楼里，
translation.en: In the fine streets and the red houses of song,

translation.zh: 常常一年又一年地流连。
translation.en: I often lingered year after year.
How fine the capital was!
I was young then,
feasting at night and having fun again in the morning.

translation.zh: 何况还有一群放纵不羁的朋友，
translation.en: And I had a band of wild, unusual friends.
Whenever there were songs

translation.zh: 有美酒，大家都争着留下来，舍不得走。
translation.en: and wine, we all wanted to stay and never leave.

translation.zh: 分别以后，时光像梭子一样飞快，
translation.en: Since then, time has flown like a weaver's shuttle.
Those old good times are like a dream,

translation.zh: 烟雾中的水路，哪里有尽头。
translation.en: and the misty waterways stretch on without end.
I think how, for fame and money,

translation.zh: 我又瘦又累，一直被它们缠住。
translation.en: I have grown thin and worn, always tied down.
Thinking back on the past
only fills my face with sorrow, for nothing.
The marker in the water clock moves,
and I begin to feel a slight chill.
Slowly there comes the low, sobbing sound

translation.zh: 几声画角，声音越来越弱。
translation.en: of a few horn calls, fading away.
By the lonely window,
I keep the lamp burning until dawn,

translation.zh: 只有影子陪着我，一夜没睡。
translation.en: with only my shadow for company, and no sleep at all.

background.zh: 《戚氏》这个词调最早见于柳永的词集，全词二百一十二个字，分三段，是宋词里最长的词调之一。这首词写一个深秋的夜晚，作者独自住在旅店里，从傍晚写到天亮，回想年轻时在京城的快乐日子，感叹为了功名到处奔波。一般认为写于柳永中年以后在外地做官、漂泊的时候。具体的年代和地点说法不一，词中提到宋玉，一说写于湖北一带的古楚地。
background.en: The tune Qi Shi first appears in Liu Yong's own collection. It has 212 characters in three stanzas, one of the longest tunes in Song ci. This lyric follows one late autumn night. The writer is alone in an inn, from dusk until dawn. He remembers his happy young days in the capital and sighs that he now runs from place to place for an official career. It is usually thought to come from his middle or later years, when he traveled and served in posts away from the capital. The exact year and place are debated. Because it mentions Song Yu, one view says it was written in the old land of Chu, around today's Hubei.

author_note.zh: 柳永（约984—约1053），原名三变，字耆卿，福建崇安人，排行第七，人称“柳七”。他年轻时常在京城的歌楼里为歌女写词，科举却多次考不中，很晚才中进士，做过屯田员外郎，所以也叫“柳屯田”。他大量写作长调慢词，善于把景物、往事和心情一层层铺开来写，这首词就是典型。
author_note.en: Liu Yong (about 984 to about 1053) was first named Sanbian, with the courtesy name Qiqing. He came from Chong'an in Fujian. He was the seventh child in his generation, so people called him Liu Qi, Liu the Seventh. When young he often wrote songs for singing girls in the capital, but he failed the imperial exams many times and passed only late in life. He served as an official in charge of farmland, which gave him another nickname. He wrote many long, slow tunes and was good at laying out scenery, memories and feelings layer by layer, as this lyric does.

appreciation.zh: 这首词像一部按时间拍的电影。第一段是傍晚：小雨、稀疏的菊花、零乱的梧桐、昏暗的夕阳，还有蝉和蟋蟀吵个不停。作者想起两千多年前同样悲秋的宋玉，觉得自己也是一个漂泊在外的人。第二段是深夜：四下安静，银河很浅，月亮很美。越是美，越让孤单的人睡不着，他开始屈指数算从前的日子。第三段回到往事：年轻时在京城，和朋友们天天喝酒唱歌。可是时光像梭子一样快，如今为了名利憔悴奔波。最后，漏壶的刻度移动，号角声断断续续，他守着灯一直坐到天亮，只有自己的影子陪着。景物、回忆、心情一层一层铺开，读完能感到长夜的寂寞和对青春的怀念。
appreciation.en: This lyric is like a film shot in time order. The first stanza is dusk: light rain, sparse chrysanthemums, messy parasol leaves, a dim sunset, and cicadas and crickets that never stop. The writer remembers Song Yu, who grieved for autumn more than two thousand years ago, and feels that he too is a lonely traveler. The second stanza is deep night. Everything is quiet, the Milky Way is pale, and the moon is lovely. The more beautiful it is, the less a lonely man can sleep, and he starts counting the years on his fingers. The third stanza goes back to the past. When he was young in the capital, he drank and sang with friends every day. But time flew like a shuttle, and now he is worn out chasing fame and money. At last the water clock moves on, horn calls come and fade, and he sits by the lamp until dawn with only his shadow for company. Scenery, memory and feeling unfold layer by layer, and you feel the loneliness of a long night and a longing for lost youth.
